question: "making a cartoon is not a piece of cake." This means that creating cartoons is:
solution:
The correct answer is "**a tough challenge**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the second paragraph of the given passage, it is mentioned that creating cartoons is a challenging and tough task in itself. The cartoon that makes us laugh the most **are the hardest to make**.
 
• Celebrated cartoonist Laxman states that he has to wait for over six hours, which includes spending a lot of time scanning newspapers and television channels before any idea strikes him.
 
• Unlike the mainstream view that making cartoons is all about **art and sketching **and hence a piece of cake, is inaccurate. It is a much more meticulous laborious process as seen in the previous statements.

Hence, the correct answer is **option 4.**
